what: dispatchTick picks probe-lane jobs first, then each (lane, source or case) group's oldest job before any group's second, in one SQL with LIMIT 12 and the usp:% exclusion; an in-process reservation admits a picked job only when its lane is under its concurrency and its stated MiB fits the unreserved budget; a job over the whole budget starts only when nothing else is held; the reservation is released in the same finally that clears each single-worker guard. Review fixes: (1) at the start of each tick the dispatcher reads from the jobs table every job handed to the processor (any operation this process does not run itself) that is running, or queued after it was sent, and counts it as holding its lane slot and MiB, for every dispatcher process; in-process jobs keep the in-memory reservation, and a job is never counted twice. (2) head-of-line: a job refused for memory is recorded with its first refusal time; once it has waited more than DISPATCH_HEAD_OF_LINE_MS (120,000 ms), no newer job outside the probe lane is admitted until it starts; records of jobs that are no longer queued or running are dropped each tick
budget: settings.dispatchMemoryMib (DISPATCH_MEMORY_MIB, a whole number of MiB) or floor(os.totalmem() / 2) in MiB
